name: Stop-Motion Paper Collage
summary: Photocopied dashboards and ransom-note words on kraft; the anomaly value is snipped out and replaced by a coral-circled clipping.
look: Kraft board, torn photocopies with halftone dots, cut-out words, masking tape and hard paper shadows. Teal and coral as misregistered riso ink; everything boils on twos.

components.name: Torn-edge mask
components.role: jagged clip-path per scrap with a hard offset paper shadow

components.name: Halftone photocopy
components.role: dot-screen background + high-contrast grain in multiply

components.name: Ransom-note words
components.role: each headline word on its own scrap, mixed serif / sans / ink

components.name: Riso block
components.role: flat teal + coral ink passes with a 6–8 px misregister

components.name: Snipped hole
components.role: the cut-out value, dashed outline showing kraft behind — the anomaly

components.name: Label-tape + pin
components.role: embossed black tape for the timestamp; a brass pin marks the human choice

motion.name: On-twos jitter
motion.how: steps(12) with a seeded ±1 px / ±0.5° boil on every scrap — reads as hand-animated at 24 fps

motion.name: Cut-in slap
motion.how: 3-frame entry, no easing, overshoot 2 % then hold; every slap is a kick or snare hit at 120 BPM

motion.name: Replacement swap
motion.how: hard-cut swap (no tween) of the cut-out scrap for the corrected clipping, landing on a downbeat

story: Hook: ransom-note words ask how many dashboards you checked over photocopied charts, then a teal “38” scrap slaps down. Reveal: the Acme mark is taped on on the drop and “Acme Pulse” prints in misregistered teal/coral riso. Proof: on a photocopied metrics sheet the checkout value is cut out, a coral-circled “−18%” clipping swaps in with label tape “since 09:42 · after deploy #2231”, and a pin lands on “Roll back”. CTA: “Caught before customers noticed.” in cut-out words and a pinned coral “Start free” scrap.
adapt: Photocopy (or screenshot and halftone) your own product screens as the scraps, and cut out the exact value your product flags; the human action becomes the pinned scrap.

fit.risk: Rawness can undercut precision; keep numbers typeset and the anomaly scrap clean.
